name: loupe-vscode
description: Design-system conformance, in the editor. Findings on save, the rule's guidance on hover, its fix as a quick fix.

loupe.path.description: The loupe executable. The default resolves `loupe` on PATH — the plugin's own bin/loupe shim, which is what passes the shipped design-system profiles. Point this at that file directly if it is not on your PATH.

loupe.enable.description: Run the language server in this workspace.
